solution_summary: eThekwini Municipality built a Microsoft-based workflow around Azure and Power BI because Urban challenges, such as ensuring safety and optimal resource usage, require a streamlined approach. Source information is captured from frontline systems, documents, transactions, images, or conversations and then processed with cloud services that classify, summarize, model, or route the data for downstream use. The resulting records are stored in shared business or analytical systems and surfaced through apps, dashboards, or case workflows so staff can move from manual review to faster action while still keeping a governed human-in-the-loop process. This turns scattered data into an operational workflow rather than a static report, making the same platform useful for both daily execution and future scaling, and This enables proactive leak detection and faster response times, ultimately improving service delivery and resource efficiency.
